title: What Are Agentic Workflows? Patterns, Use Cases and Examples | Valorem Reply
snippet: Agentic workflows represent a significant advancement in how artificial intelligence systems operate and deliver value to businesses. Unlike traditional automation that follows rigid, predetermined paths, agentic workflows enable AI systems to work with purpose, adaptability, and goal-oriented behavior. According to recent research published in IEEE (Jain et al., 2024), agentic workflows are transforming how organizations approach complex problem-solving by providing structured frameworks for [...] Research into agentic workflows has accelerated dramatically in recent years. A groundbreaking paper from IEEE (Document 10578990) explored how agentic workflows enable "systematic approaches to problem decomposition and solution generation in large language models." The researchers found that properly structured workflows improved complex reasoning tasks by 42% compared to single-prompt approaches. [...] For companies navigating digital transformation, understanding agentic workflows isn't just about staying current with technology trends—it's about gaining concrete competitive advantages. Organizations implementing well-designed agentic workflows report efficiency gains of up to 40% in knowledge work processes, according to the recent study "Enhancing AI Systems with Agentic Workflows" (Zhang et al., 2024).

title: What Are Agentic Workflows? Everything You Need To Know | Vonage
snippet:
A recent report from Deloitte states that 25% of enterprises using GenAI plan to deploy AI agents in 2025. These virtual agents are powered by technology such as large language models (LLMs)  and natural language processing (NLP).

But how can you get the most out of these technologies? Enter agentic workflows. This article spotlights how agentic workflows can improve the accuracy and capabilities of the AI tools you use.

Explore Vonage AI Hub

Illustration of a robot 

Rachel Weinberg [...] Agentic workflows are frameworks for autonomous AI. An AI agent makes decisions, executes actions, and coordinates tasks with little to no human intervention. These workflows leverage core technologies such as natural language processing and machine learning. They break tasks down into subtasks and often collaborate with multiple AI specialist agents.

Agentic workflows increase efficiency when using AI tools. They’re also more adaptable and flexible than traditional workflows. [...] Agentic workflows introduce new capabilities and applications for using AI and AI-related tools. Let’s examine some of the primary advantages of building agentic workflows into your business operations:
